description: Register an outbound webhook (up to 3 per organization, https only). Events: token.verified / token.used / token.cancelled / token.transferred / queue.approaching (defaults to all; queue.approaching fires only when the location policy sets approachingThreshold). The response includes the signing secret (whsec_...) EXACTLY ONCE — deliveries are signed via the x-rightos-signature header (t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>). Requires the RIGHTOS_API_KEY environment variable (operator API key).

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (defaults to all five)

url.description: https URL to receive signed POST deliveries

name: create_webhook
